    SELECT interactfanpivot, SUM(giftvalusd) as total_gift_value
    FROM interactions
    GROUP BY interactfanpivot
),
whale_check AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry,
        f.nicklabel,
        COALESCE(fg.total_gift_value, 0) as total_gift_value,
        ms.spendusd,
        CASE WHEN fg.total_gift_value > 500 OR ms.spendusd > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_whale

)
SELECT 
    userregistry,
    nicklabel,
    ROUND(CAST(total_gift_value + spendusd AS numeric), 2) as total_support
FROM whale_check
WHERE is_whale = 1
ORDER BY total_support DESC;
